row.title: What Leo remembers
row.waiting: {count, plural, one {# waiting for your answer} other {# waiting for your answer}}

dialog.title: What Leo remembers
dialog.description: Facts Leo uses in its answers, each with where it came from. Correct, pin or forget any of them.

off: Memory is off: Leo doesn’t use or save memories. Nothing here is deleted.

candidates.title: Should Leo remember this?
candidates.description: Leo won’t use these until you answer.

empty.title: Leo doesn’t remember anything yet
empty.description: Leo learns from what you tell it in chats and meetings. Each fact shows up here with where it came from.

forgetAll.title: Forget everything Leo remembers?
forgetAll.description: Leo deletes {count, plural, one {# fact} other {all # facts}} and the memory summary at once. You can’t undo this.

imported.title: From your earlier memory
imported.description: Leo carried these over from your earlier memory. None is used until you answer.
imported.confirmDescription: Leo won’t use any of the facts carried over from your earlier memory. You can’t undo this.
